parts:
Hi all,
i am a beginner of NicheMapR,
i am playing with this Getting to start: https://mrke.github.io/getting_started/
however, when i use these two functions,
micro<-micro_ncep(loc = loc, dstart = dstart, dfinish = dfinish)
micro<-micro_ncep(loc = loc, dstart = dstart, dfinish = dfinish)

i always got errors notice:
downloading DEM via package elevatr
Error in if (nrow(locations) == 1 & lll & is.null(expand)) { :
argument is of length zero

i am not sure whether this is because of elevatr package, would someone explain about this? thanks.
Gengping

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: On Getting to start of NicheMapR
parts:
Hi GenPing,

It does sound like it is something going wrong with elevatr - perhaps try somethings just with that package and see if that's where the issue lies. E.g.

library(elevatr)
library(sp)
library(raster)
lat <- -35
long <- 145
resolution <- 30
zmin <- 0
xdims <- 200
ydims <- 200
xy <- data.frame(x = long, y = lat)
coordinates(xy)  <- ~x + y
proj4string(xy)  <- "+init=epsg:4326"
xy <- as.data.frame(spTransform(xy, CRS("+init=epsg:3395")))
e <- extent(c(xy$x - floor(xdims/2) * resolution, xy$x +
                ceiling(xdims/2) * resolution, xy$y - floor(ydims/2) *
                resolution, xy$y + ceiling(ydims/2) * resolution))
r <- raster(e)
res(r) <- resolution
crs(r) <- "+init=epsg:3395"
z  <- ceiling(log((cos(lat * pi/180) * 2 * pi * 6378137)/(256 * resolution), 2))
z <- ifelse(z > 14, 14, z)
r2 <- get_elev_raster(r, z = z, src = "aws")
plot(r2)

All the best,
Mike

messages.subject: Re: On Getting to start of NicheMapR

Hi Fede,

I had the same problem a while ago, and I contacted Ilya Maclean, since the problem seemed associated to microclima. It turned out to be related to elevatr, and the solution that work for me (as suggested by Ilya) was to downgrade elevatr. With elevatr vs 0.2.0 everything seems to work:

require(remotes)
install_version("elevatr", version = "0.2.0", repos = "http://cran.us.r-project.org")

Hope this helps!
Urtzi
